def connect_markers_perpendicular(grid, marker=2, line=3):
    """Join marker pairs sharing a row or column with a line; every other marker extends along its row/column to the nearest such line, meeting it."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == marker]
    def span(a, b):
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = a, b
        if r1 == r2: return [(r1, j) for j in range(min(c1, c2), max(c1, c2) + 1)]
        if c1 == c2: return [(i, c1) for i in range(min(r1, r2), max(r1, r2) + 1)]
        return []
    trunk = set()
    for x in range(len(pts)):
        for y in range(x + 1, len(pts)):
            s = span(pts[x], pts[y])
            if s:
                for i, j in s:
                    if out[i][j] == 0: out[i][j] = line
